title: Magazine p. 55: "Exclusive NASA Photos" Apollo 11 UFO with "halo-like force field"
description: Photocopied magazine page reproducing a tabloid-style image with the banners "EXCLUSIVE NASA PHOTOS" and "These Are The Photos Taken When Your TV Screens Went Blank!" over a photograph of a faint circular halo (numbered 26). The reproduced caption reads "This photo was snapped only moments after Aldrin's other Apollo 11 shot. Here the two UFOs have begun their separation and a halo-like force field between the two is clearly shown." The magazine's own caption states the Apollo-11 spots "are highly magnified window reflections in Lunar Module deep in space."
